highlights.title: Drag and drop works again
highlights.text: Files dragged in from Finder, Explorer or your desktop land in the chat again. In 0.8.0 and 0.8.1 the drop card showed, but letting go did nothing.

highlights.title: Drop onto any chat
highlights.text: A bot's chat, a team chat, #general or a message to an @mention. Before you let go, the card still says who gets them.
